title: Bluewater View
meta_description: Bluewater View: Four-story coastal retreat near Inlet Beach with balconies, spacious living, bikes, and easy beach access.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Bluewater View by AvantStay!

Perched in the heart of Inlet Beach, this stunning four-story retreat blends coastal charm with modern design, offering the perfect setting for families and groups to gather, unwind, and explore Florida's Emerald Coast. Just a short stroll or bike ride away, you'll find sugar-white sands and turquoise waters---simply hop on one of the provided bikes and head straight down neighborhood paths to the nearest beach access point.

Inside, a bright and contemporary open layout makes it easy to connect. Gather in the inviting living room, where a plush sofa, fireplace, and flat-screen TV create a cozy space for movie nights. The fully equipped kitchen---complete with a large island, barstool seating, and all the essentials---flows seamlessly into the dining area, where a circular table sets the stage for memorable meals together.

With five bedrooms and flexible sleeping options, everyone will find their perfect retreat. The thoughtfully designed bunk room is ideal for kids or friends sharing space, while the additional bedrooms offer serene escapes with modern comfort. A pullout sofa in the living room adds even more sleeping flexibility. Four full bathrooms plus a half bath ensure convenience for groups of all sizes.

Step outside to take in Gulf breezes from multiple balconies or enjoy the privacy of your patio. After a day at the beach, rinse off, refresh with in-home laundry, and settle in for sunset views. With parking included and nearby access to the shops and dining of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, and Alys Beach, your group will be perfectly positioned to experience the best of 30A.

Bluewater View is where beach days, bike rides, and unforgettable gatherings all come together.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note that the elevator is not for guest use.

Parking Details:
- Parking is available for four cars in the driveway.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
